Harborview Orthopedic Spine Center
Spine Consultation
Patient: Dario Vasquez | DOB: 06/25/1953 | MRN: SYN-4729739
Date of service: 11/09/2025 | Dr. Sanne Merriweather, DO

Reason for consultation:
Low back pain with right leg symptoms, referred by Dr. Felix Iverson, MD.

Review of systems:
No trouble controlling urine or stool, no numbness in the groin area, no fevers, stable weight, and no prior malignancy.

Physical exam:
Back: tenderness over the lower lumbar paraspinal muscles; straight-leg raise positive on the right at 40 degrees.
Neuro: strength 4/5 in right plantar flexion, right Achilles reflex 1+, decreased light touch over the lateral right foot.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: right S1 lumbar radiculopathy.
Plan: MRI lumbar spine without contrast to evaluate for disc herniation; home exercise program; follow up after imaging.
